features.title: Generation (de-novo backbones at chosen epitope[s])
features.done_criteria: Backbone pools from >=2 generators (RFd3/Genie3/BoltzGen/PXDesign) at apical + conserved epitopes; generator ranking re-established for THIS geometry; nanobody arm decided
features.notes: Do NOT assume TNF's Genie3+PXDesign ranking; re-test on a concave, precedented epitope.

features.title: Sequence design (ProteinMPNN / LigandMPNN; cross-species JOINT multi-state)
features.done_criteria: 0-Cys sequences; joint multi-state MPNN over human+mouse where cross-react targeted (--pdb_path_multi + symmetry_residues)

features.title: Binding validation (af2ig + Boltz-2 + Chai; ipSAE/ipSAE_min; self-consistency)
features.done_criteria: Per-design human binding confirmed by >=2 independent folders; de-novo af2ig positive control; ipSAE_min across species; self-consistency recorded
features.notes: af2ig positive control MUST be de-novo (natural binders fold to garbage single-seq).

features.title: pH-switch install + 4-class validation
features.done_criteria: His switch installed (mech B default; A where a conserved cation exists); direction+selectivity via two-state MD (+Gln-isostere control) + PROPKA/pKAI linkage + GFN2-xTB, contact-gated; re-folded
features.notes: Switch magnitude is in-silico-unrankable -> select for diversity; gate on direction purity.

features.title: Cross-species energetic validation (mouse)
features.done_criteria: Every design tested energetically on mouse with matched protonation; dual-species releasers featured; anti-switchers demoted
features.notes: Human switch often human-specific (TNF ~5/18). Don't assume transfer; test directly.

features.title: Novelty + developability
features.done_criteria: Structural TM + seq-id gate vs PDB/AFDB AND vs 6WRV/TB14/viral binders; 0-Cys; SAP; expression screen (ESMFold monomer pLDDT + consensus)

features.title: Assembly + selection (<=20, diverse, ranked)
features.done_criteria: <=20 designs, ranked by objective priority, <=2 per lineage, validator exits 0 for the track

features.title: Methods writeup + submission package (user-gated upload)
